name: TESLA MINI BOT
description: Modular WhatsApp bot worker with PostgreSQL-backed sessions. Requires a durable PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL.

DATABASE_URL.description: Persistent PostgreSQL connection string. Required; Heroku dyno storage is ephemeral.

OWNER_NUMBERS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp owner numbers in international digits-only format.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Optional owner phone number in international digits only; set for first pairing, then remove.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional: enables AI chat, image generation, text-to-speech and transcription.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Optional: enables web and video search.

MEDIA_PROVIDER_URL.description: Optional trusted HTTPS media-download API endpoint.

MEDIA_PROVIDER_KEY.description: Optional key for the configured media-download provider.

HEROKU_DEPLOY_WEBHOOK.description: Optional HTTPS deployment-pipeline hook used by .updatebot.
